models.mechanism: The oath can be heard as an image of bodies driven forward so hard that motion becomes audible breath. The focus is not only speed, but expenditure: running crosses from silent capacity into voiced strain.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: running and hastening, especially the running of horses or people on foot
activation_trace.assigned_role: supplies the primary moving body and forward impulse

activation_trace.literal_contribution: audible breath or mouth-sound of horses while running
activation_trace.assigned_role: turns the motion into an acoustic sign of exertion

activation_trace.literal_contribution: running with stretched forelegs or light running
activation_trace.assigned_role: adds a visible gait that matches the panting sound

structural_cues: The two lexical items are adjacent: the runner is immediately followed by the manner or sound of exertion.
The accusative-like adverbial noun ضبحا functions naturally as the mode in which العاديات run.
Both roots contain running branches, so the verse doubles motion through actor plus manner.

abductive_moves.assumption: Audible panting marks not incidental noise but the threshold where speed consumes the body's reserve.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The packet supplies running and breath-sound, but not the evaluive claim that breath reveals expenditure.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: supplied elements: running body plus breath-sound; inferred arrow: intense running causes audible strain, and the strain reframes the runner as spent or committed.
alternatives: ضبحا could be merely descriptive animal sound without emphasis on depletion.
The line could foreground velocity alone, not exertion.

changed_reading.after: By beings in rapid motion whose very breath exposes the cost and intensity of their drive.

minimal_triggers: adjacency of runner and panting manner
models.ablation: Removing ض ب ح/B001 leaves fast runners but collapses the reading of audible expenditure; removing ع د و/B002 leaves breath or gait without the forward drive.

models.mechanism: The runners may be not neutral racers but agents of incursion: movement is a crossing of a limit, and the panting belongs to the pressure of entering another's space. The ayah then carries a dormant social or martial edge even before any later context is known.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: overstepping a bound into injustice, aggression, attacking, or raiding
activation_trace.assigned_role: casts the running as transgressive entry rather than sport or neutral travel
supplies the social polarity in which the runner has an opposed target
provides the bodily immediacy of an oncoming force

structural_cues: The root ع د و holds both running and aggression branches, so the same surface can pivot from locomotion to hostile crossing.
The plural participial form العاديات can name a class of agents, allowing a collective incursion model.
The breath noun follows as a manner, making the hostile crossing feel embodied and imminent rather than abstract.

abductive_moves.assumption: A branch of overstepping can color the runners when no explicit destination is given, because unbounded motion invites the question of what limit is being crossed.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The packet supplies aggression and running under the same root, but the verse itself does not state a victim or boundary.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: supplied elements: root-internal link between running and transgression; inferred arrow: lack of stated endpoint permits the motion to be read as crossing into contested space.
alternatives: The oath may intend only the racing branch B002.
Aggression may remain dormant until a later ayah supplies target, collision, or spoil.

changed_reading.after: By a collective rush whose panting is the sound of pressure crossing a boundary, possibly toward an enemy or unlawful seizure.

models.ablation: Removing ع د و/B001 makes the model generic speed; removing ع د و/B003 weakens the social opposition and leaves only physical crossing.

models.mechanism: The motion may imply contact with resistant ground: hard, uneven terrain and stretched running generate friction, heat, and darkened residue. This turns the panting racers into a material process in which force leaves a scorch-like trace.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: hard dry ground, uneven place, unstable seat
activation_trace.assigned_role: supplies the resistant surface over which the running occurs

activation_trace.literal_contribution: scorching the top of wood or things touched by fire
activation_trace.assigned_role: converts violent motion into a heat or burning trace

activation_trace.literal_contribution: slight blackening by fire or sun
activation_trace.assigned_role: marks the visible residue of that heat
offers an end-state image of what intense contact can leave behind

structural_cues: The focus ayah joins locomotion to ضبحا, whose inventory includes both breath-sound and fire-scorch branches.
The hard-ground branch of ع د و provides a plausible medium for converting running into frictional heat.
This reading depends on material sequence: surface resistance, forceful contact, heat, darkening or ash.

abductive_moves.assumption: The panting sound can be analogically linked to heated friction because ض ب ح contains both breath and scorching branches.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: No explicit fire is in the focus line; the move is activated only by dormant branch inventory and a plausible physical mechanism.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: supplied elements: hard/uneven ground and scorch/darkening branches; inferred arrow: rapid contact against resistance produces heat-like trace.
alternatives: The fire branches may be unrelated homonymous imagery not meant to affect this verse.
The line may remain entirely auditory and kinetic.

changed_reading.after: By rushing bodies whose contact with resistant ground is imagined as heat, blackening, or ash-producing force.

minimal_triggers: sequence from resistant surface to heated trace
models.ablation: Removing the scorch and blackening branches of ض ب ح collapses the material heat reading; removing ع د و/B010 leaves fire imagery without a surface that explains why running would produce it.

surprise_reading: Focus-only, the ayah can hold several provisional baselines: racers whose panting reveals the bodily cost of speed; a collective rush that may already lean toward boundary-crossing incursion; and, more speculatively, motion over resistant ground imagined as friction, heat, darkening, or ash-like trace.
